summary: Ad hoc commands run a single module with /usr/bin/ansible instead of a playbook: select hosts or groups in an inventory, click Run Command and choose a module such as command, shell, yum, apt, service, user, ping, setup or win_* modules.
questions: How do I run an ad hoc command in AAP?
Which modules can I use for ad hoc commands in controller?
How do I reboot many hosts quickly from controller?
What is an ad hoc command?
